description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You reroute power to your limbs to launch yourself through the air like a rocket. You [[/act leap]] to an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 feet. When you land, all adjacent spaces become difficult terrain as your impact shatters the ground, and you can make a melee Strike against a creature of your choice within reach. On a hit, the target is additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone] by the force of your blow.
